title: Director of Digital Strategy & Communications
bio: I am responsible for establishing and setting communication goals and priorities that advance the work of the department and illuminate the richly complex and multi-faceted undergraduate experience at Harvard. Working closely with the Dean of Students and senior leaders in the areas of Residential Life and the First-Year Experience, Office of Culture & Community, and Student Engagement, I determine the most effective and strategic means and methods to share their messages with a variety of audiences, including students, parents, alumni, staff, and faculty.
